summary: Ensure branch-protection required checks constitution and dependency-security are created for every pull request targeting main, instead of being suppressed by pull_request path filters.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator instructed continuation after the required-check deadlock was identified and the fix was stated to preserve, not bypass, branch protection.
implementation: .github/workflows/constitution-check.yml runs on every pull request targeting main while retaining push-side path filtering
.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml runs on every pull request targeting main
branch-protection required checks remain fail-closed and are not bypassed
mandatoryRules: required checks must always materialize on pull requests targeting main
path filtering must not suppress a required branch-protection check
constitutional and dependency security validation must remain blocking on failure
no direct main write or branch-protection bypass is permitted
rollback: Revert the workflow trigger changes and this amendment only through the guarded C2 path. Do not disable branch protection or mark required checks optional as a rollback shortcut.
